narrative:
Mahoning County has 155,010 registered voters, with 18.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 12.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 55.3%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 42.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.9% of registrants. Registration is trending redder in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +11.9% D−R vs +27.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
